name: Heavy Lifter
idea: A chunky, engineered worker ant strides along with a parcel far bigger than itself pressed up overhead, retelling the fact everyone loves (ants carry 50 times their weight) as CNX's promise: small, fast, carries anything.
why: It is a story people already know and will retell in five words, "the ant lifting a huge box", and the tilted jade parcel over a black ant stays one distinct silhouette from a van side down to a 32 px icon.
risks: Some people see ants as pests, which is an odd thought next to their parcels, and with six legs and two antennae the mark is busier than a pictogram, so below about 24 px it shrinks to a green box on a dark bug and the parcel does most of the recognising.
